## Main questions

```{r}
tdata_main <- subset(tdata, select = c(1:2, 5, 6, 16:18))


tdata_main <- tdata_main %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(6:7), # Select columns to pivot
    names_to = "case", # Names for new columns
    values_to = "rating" # Separator in original column names
  )



tdata_main$causation_type <- factor(tdata_main$causation_type, levels = c("generative", "preventive"), 
                          labels = c("generative", "preventive"))

tdata_main$case <- factor(tdata_main$case, levels = c("case_01", "case_09"), 
                          labels = c("wac = 0.1", "wac = 0.9"))



tdata_main$rating <- tdata_main$rating * 0.01 # convert to 0-1 scale

```




### Graphs

#### Predictions 

Function computing P(e|c) under the preventive CCCF CBN

```{r}
p_ec_ccm_cf <- function(w_ce, w_ae, w_ac, b_a, check = TRUE) {

  if (check) {
    if (any(is.na(c(w_ce, w_ae, w_ac, b_a))))
      stop("Inputs must not be NA.")
    
    if (any(c(w_ce, w_ae, w_ac, b_a) < 0 | 
            c(w_ce, w_ae, w_ac, b_a) > 1)) {
      warning("Inputs are typically probabilities/weights in [0,1]. Proceeding anyway.")
    }

    denom <- 1 - b_a * w_ac
    if (isTRUE(all.equal(denom, 0)))
      stop("Invalid inputs: denominator equals 0 (division by zero).")
  }

  frac <- (b_a * (1 - w_ac)) / (1 - b_a * w_ac)

  w_ce + (w_ae - w_ce) * frac
}


```


for w_ac = 0.1

```{r}
p_ec_ccm_cf(
  w_ce = 0.3,
  w_ae = 0.9,
  w_ac = 0.1,
  b_a  = 0.2
) -> prediction_1p
prediction_1p
```
for w_ac = 0.9

```{r}
p_ec_ccm_cf(
  w_ce = 0.3,
  w_ae = 0.9,
  w_ac = 0.9,
  b_a  = 0.2
) -> prediction_2p
prediction_2p
```


Function computing P(e|c) under the generative CCCF CBN

```{r}
p_ec_cccf <- function(w_ce, w_ae, w_ac, b_a, b_c, check = TRUE) {
  if (check) {
    if (any(is.na(c(w_ce, w_ae, w_ac, b_a, b_c))))
      stop("Inputs must not be NA.")
    
    if (any(c(w_ce, w_ae, w_ac, b_a, b_c) < 0 | 
            c(w_ce, w_ae, w_ac, b_a, b_c) > 1)) {
      warning("Inputs are typically probabilities/weights in [0, 1]. Proceeding anyway.")
    }

    denom <- w_ac*b_a + b_c - w_ac*b_c*b_a
    if (isTRUE(all.equal(denom, 0)))
      stop("Invalid inputs: denominator equals 0 (division by zero).")
  }

  numerator   <- w_ac*b_a + b_c*b_a - w_ac*b_c*b_a
  denominator <- w_ac*b_a + b_c - w_ac*b_c*b_a

  w_ce + (1 - w_ce) * w_ae * (numerator / denominator)
}

```


for w_ac = 0.1

```{r}
p_ec_cccf(
  w_ce = 0.3,
  w_ae = 0.9,
  w_ac = 0.1,
  b_a  = 0.2,
  b_c  = 0.2
) -> prediction_1g
prediction_1g
```

for w_ac = 0.9

```{r}
p_ec_cccf(
  w_ce = 0.3,
  w_ae = 0.9,
  w_ac = 0.9,
  b_a  = 0.2,
  b_c  = 0.2
) -> prediction_2g
prediction_2g
```

```{r}
library(afex)

a1
```


```{r}
library(emmeans)
# means
group_means <- emmeans(a1, c("case", "causation_type")) 
group_means
```

Test the pairs:

```{r}
pairs(emmeans(a1, ~ causation_type*case), adjust = "none") -> deltas

print("pair contrasts and test statistics")
cat("\n\n") 
deltas 

cat("\n\n") 


confint(deltas, level = 0.95) -> diff_data
print("pair contrasts and their CIs")
cat("\n\n") 
diff_data
```

```{r}
pairs(pairs(emmeans(a1, ~ causation_type*case)), adjust = "none") -> deltas_deltas

print("difference of differences and test statistics")
cat("\n\n") 
deltas_deltas 



confint(deltas_deltas, level = 0.95) -> diff_diff_data
print("pair contrasts and their CIs")
cat("\n\n") 
diff_diff_data
```

# Clusters 



```{r}
library(dplyr)

# --- 2. Define the Margin of Error ---
margin_of_error <- 3 # 3% margin (scale from 0 to 100)

# --- 3. Cluster Participants ---
tdata_clusters <- tdata %>%
  mutate(
    # Calculate the difference for easier understanding
    rating_difference = case_09 - case_01,
    
    cluster = case_when(
      # Condition 1: No change (absolute difference is within the margin)
      # This condition must come FIRST to give precedence to the margin
      abs(rating_difference) <= margin_of_error ~ "no change",
      
      # Condition 2: Increase 
      rating_difference > margin_of_error ~ "increase",
      
      # Condition 3: Decrease
      rating_difference < -margin_of_error ~ "decrease",
      
      # Optional: A catch-all for any cases not covered (shouldn't happen with these conditions)
      TRUE ~ NA_character_ 
    )
  )



tdata_clusters$causation_type <- factor(tdata_clusters$causation_type, levels = c("generative", "preventive"), 
                          labels = c("generative", "preventive"))

```


create the data frame with the counts

```{r}

library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

cluster_summary <- tdata_clusters %>%
  group_by(causation_type, cluster) %>% # Group by both structure and cluster
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100)




# add rows that contain 0 counts (if those exist)
cluster_summary <- cluster_summary %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  complete(causation_type, cluster) %>%
  mutate(
    n = replace_na(n, 0),
    percentage = replace_na(percentage, 0)
  )


```





Graphs 


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(binom)

cluster_summary <- tdata_clusters %>%
  count(causation_type, cluster, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(causation_type) %>%
  mutate(
    n_total = sum(n),
    p = n / n_total,
    percentage = 100 * p
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Wilson 95% CI for each bar
  bind_cols(
    binom.confint(
      x = .$n,
      n = .$n_total,
      methods = "wilson"
    ) %>%
      transmute(
        ci_low  = 100 * lower,
        ci_high = 100 * upper
      )
  )

clusters_plot <- cluster_summary

g4 <- ggplot(clusters_plot, aes(x = cluster, y = percentage, fill = causation_type)) +
  guides(fill = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ causation_type, labeller = labeller(causation_type = comp_labels),
             nrow = 1, strip.position = "top") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1, 101), breaks = seq(0, 100, 10), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", alpha = 0.6, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high),
    width = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(percentage, 1), "%")), vjust = -0.5) +
  labs(x = "Cluster", y = "Percentage",
       title = title_text, subtitle = subtitle_text, caption = caption_text) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#367A5D", "#D19032", "#296398", "#984335", "#8E7CC3")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("#367A5D", "#D19032", "#296398", "#984335", "#8E7CC3")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(family = body_font, size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(family = body_font, size = 12),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    plot.subtitle = element_blank(),
    plot.caption = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(color = "white", fill = "white"),
    plot.margin = margin(20, 40, 20, 40)
  )

g4

```



```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(showtext)
library(RColorBrewer)

# 1. Define the Okabe-Ito Palette (Publication standard)
# This is a hand-picked professional palette
pub_palette <- c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#F0E442", "#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#CC79A7")

# 2. Updated Mean Plot (G3)
g3 <- ggplot(tdata_sub, aes(x = case, y = rating, fill = causation_type, color = causation_type)) +
  facet_wrap(~ causation_type, labeller = labeller(causation_type = comp_labels), nrow = 1) +
  #facet_wrap( ~ causation_type, labeller = labeller(causation_type = comp_labels), nrow = 1, strip.position = "top")+
  # Background individual lines
  geom_line(aes(group = subj_code), 
            position = position_jitter(height = 0.02, width = 0.05), 
            linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.2, color = NA, trim = TRUE) +
  
  # Summary: Color-matched lines and points
  stat_summary(aes(group = 1), fun.data = mean_cl_boot, geom = "errorbar", width = 0, linewidth = 0.8) +
  stat_summary(aes(group = 1), fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 1.1) +
  stat_summary(aes(group = 1), fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 21, size = 3.5, stroke = 1.2, fill = "white") +
  
  # Model Predictions (Black squares)
  geom_point(data = preds_plot, aes(x = case, y = prediction), 
             color = "black", fill = "black", size = 2.2, shape = 22) + 

  # Scales & Labels
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.05), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pub_palette) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pub_palette) +
  labs(x = "Parameter Value", y = expression(bold(paste("P(e|c) Rating")))) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "body_font"),

    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10), face = "bold"),

  )
```
